description:
# Reference: DPC4-ChampSim/replacement/mockingjay, single-core build. Sizes are for
# the DPC4 LLC, 4096 x 12: INF_RD 95, INF_ETR 11, MAX_RD 73, 11-bit signatures,
# 32 sampled sets. The multi-core build folds the core id instead of the hit bit,
# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay
doc: >
  Mockingjay: each line holds an estimated time to reuse (ETR), counted down every
  8 accesses to its set; the victim is the line with the largest |ETR|, an overdue
  (negative) one on ties. A predictor table keyed by the hit-or-miss PC signature
  gives the ETR on insertion, and a fill predicted to be reused after every line in
  the set is bypassed. A sampled shadow cache on 32 sets measures reuse distances
  with an 8-bit per-set clock and trains the predictor one step at a time; entries
  older than INF_RD train it up as scans. Writebacks are inserted at -INF_ETR and
  train nothing.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

# Change: Make bypass condition stricter by ANDing the two original conditions.
# This is to address the very high number of wrong_bypass mistakes, which suggest
# the policy is too eager to bypass.
name: mockingjay_stricter_bypass
doc: >
  Mockingjay with a stricter bypass condition. The original Mockingjay bypasses if
  the predicted reuse distance is high OR if it's longer than the victim's. This
  version requires both conditions to hold, making it more conservative about
  bypassing, to reduce wrong_bypass mistakes.

    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set

    kind: counter

    init: ZERO

victim:

  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # Bypass only when predicted reuse is high AND exceeds victim's
    - table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}

    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}

    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:

      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true

        free: true

      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}

    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

    set: {etr: {const: -11}}

  place: condition
  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature, rdp_thresh: {int: [0, 127]}}
  means: >
    True when the entry for the index in rdp_table is present and its value is
    greater than rdp_thresh, AND the entry for the same index in conf_table has
    reached its maximum value. An absent entry in rdp_table causes the condition
    to be false.

  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature, div: {int: [1, 128]}}

    index in conf_table has reached its maximum value, AND the value of
    rdp_table[index] divided by div is greater than the absolute value of the
    key of the victim way. An absent rdp_table entry is treated as 0.

description:
# name: mockingjay_confidence
# doc: >
#  Adds a confidence table to qualify bypass predictions. This is to reduce
#  wrong_bypasses, where the predictor wrongly suggests bypassing a line that will
#  be reused. A bypass now only happens if the prediction is marked as confident.
#  Confidence is trained up on correct predictions (reuses) and down on incorrect
#  ones (evictions before reuse) observed by the sampler. To make space for the
#  confidence table, the per-set clock is narrowed from 8 to 7 bits.
name: mockingjay_confidence
doc: >
  Mockingjay with confidence-based bypass. A 2-bit confidence counter is added
  for each entry in the reuse-distance predictor (RDP) table. This confidence
  is incremented when the sampler observes a reuse, and decremented when a
  sampled line is evicted before reuse. A fill is only bypassed if the RDP
  predicts a long reuse distance AND the confidence for that prediction is high.
  This is intended to reduce the number of wrong bypasses. The state for the
  confidence table is paid for by reducing the width of the sampler's timestamp
  clock from 8 to 7 bits.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 7                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; narrowed from 8 to make space
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # Bypass only on confident long-reuse predictions
    - table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}
      is_confident: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 2}
    - table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}
      is_confident: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 2}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO} # Narrowed from 8
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      # Prefetch match: train RDP and confidence, then stop
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
        stop: true
      # Other match (LOAD, RFO): train RDP and confidence
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true

  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}

- name: is_confident
  place: condition
  params: {table: table, index: signature, threshold: {int: [0, 3]}}
  means: >
    True when the entry of the table at the index is greater than or equal to the threshold.

name: mj_ema_train
doc: >

  The original Mockingjay predictor learns very slowly, updating its prediction by
  only one step at a time towards a measured reuse distance. This can lead to
  persistent mispredictions. This version replaces the slow update rule with an
  exponential moving average (EMA), allowing the predictor to adapt much more
  quickly to observed reuse behavior. This should improve prediction accuracy and
  reduce the number of wrong bypass decisions.

  incremented on observed reuses and decremented on evictions before reuse.

- name: deconfident_rdp_gt

  params:

doc: >
  Introduces more nuance into ETR setting and bypass decisions. ETR is now also
  set to max for moderately high RDPs if confidence is max, helping evict dead
  lines sooner. Bypass is refined: the absolute RDP-based bypass requires max
  confidence, reducing wrong bypasses, while the relative bypass remains lenient.

    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: back to Mockingjay's default

    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:

description:
name: mj_comprehensive_confidence
doc: >
  Integrates confidence into all prediction aspects: eviction priority (ETR) and
  bypass decisions. A new value word calculates ETR from a confidence-adjusted RDP,
  making lines with low-confidence predictions easier to evict, combating kept_dead
  errors. Bypass logic uses confidence-adjusted RDP for both absolute and relative
  tests to reduce wrong_bypasses. Faster aging and sensitive RDP training are retained.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 4                   # GRANULARITY: age faster
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, scale: 4, threshold: 73}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: bypass_confidence
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: 1                   # Start with neutral confidence

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: increment} # Reuse -> increase confidence
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement} # Old -> decrease confidence
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement} # Replaced before use -> decrease confidence
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 4}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 4}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when:
        deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, scale: 4, threshold: 73}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {deconfident_etr_from_rdp: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
name: mj_etr_conf_penalty
doc: >
  Introduces a confidence penalty to the ETR calculation to create a more nuanced
  eviction rank, addressing both kept_dead and wrong_bypass errors. A new value
  word, confidence_penalized_etr, lowers the ETR for lines with low-confidence
  reuse predictions, making them better eviction candidates. Bypass logic is also
  refined using deconfident_exceeds_victim, which penalizes low-confidence
  predictions when comparing against the victim's ETR.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Absolute bypass: high RDP and some confidence
    - high_rdp_and_confident_bypass: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, rdp_thresh: 73, conf_thresh: 0}
    # Relative bypass: predicted ETR, penalized for low confidence, exceeds victim's ETR
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {conf_table: bypass_confidence, rdp_table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 8}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: bypass_confidence
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement}
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    # Special case for very long reuse: set ETR to max
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # General case: set ETR from RDP, penalized by low confidence
    - set:
        etr:
          confidence_penalized_etr:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: bypass_confidence
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
name: mockingjay_unified_rank
doc: >
  Unifies the eviction rank (ETR) calculation for insertion and bypass decisions to
  resolve the conflict between kept_dead and wrong_bypass errors. A new value word,
  confidence_ranked_etr, computes a single rank from both RDP and confidence. A new
  condition word, predicted_rank_exceeds_victim, uses this unified rank for bypass.
  Also adopts more selective confidence training from top designs to strengthen the
  confidence signal.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; kept at full width
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - predicted_rank_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO} # Kept at full width
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Unified ETR calculation using RDP and confidence
    - set: {etr: {confidence_ranked_etr: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, max_etr: 11}}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access
new_words_text:
- name: confidence_ranked_etr
  place: value
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    max_etr:
      int: [0, 15]
    rdp_table: table
  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. 'conf_val' is read from its table, with an
    absent entry read as its init value (0). The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    If rdp_val is greater than 73, the function returns max_etr. Otherwise, it
    calculates a base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division. It calculates an
    adjustment = (3 - conf_val). The final returned value is min(max_etr, base_etr + adjustment).
- name: deconfident_rdp_gt
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
    threshold:
      int: [0, 127]
  means: 'Reads the value ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An
    absent entry in rdp_table is treated as a value of 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized,
    and its maximum value is 3. Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val)
    * scale). If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0. Returns true if this adjusted_rdp
    is greater than the threshold.

    '
- name: predicted_rank_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    max_etr:
      int: [0, 15]
    rdp_table: table
  means: >
    Calculates a predicted ETR for an incoming line. It reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index]
    and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index]. An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. An absent 'conf_val'
    is read as its init value (0). If rdp_val is greater than 73, the predicted ETR is max_etr.
    Otherwise, a base_etr is calculated as rdp_val / div using integer division, and an
    adjustment is calculated as (3 - conf_val). The predicted ETR is min(max_etr, base_etr + adjustment).
    The condition is true if this predicted ETR is greater than the absolute value of the victim way's key.
- name: train_sampler_match
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    conf_thresh:
      int: [0, 127]
    index: signature
    min_diff:
      int: [0, 127]
    rdp_table: table
    sample: state
    scale:
      int: [1, 2]
  means: >
    Performs training for a sampler match based on the reuse distance 'sample' (age).
    First, it trains the rdp_table using the 'toward' operation. The target value is min(sample * scale, rdp_table.max). The entry moves one step toward the target if the difference from the target is at least min_diff.
    Second, if the 'sample' value is less than conf_thresh, it increments the conf_table entry at the same index.

description:
name: mj_confidence_rework
doc: >
  Reworks confidence integration to address performance degradation and specific
  error types. `etr_clock` granularity is reverted to original Mockingjay (8)
  to prevent overly fast aging leading to `evicted_sooner`. Confidence for bypass
  is now an explicit check (rdp > threshold AND confidence > 0) to reduce `wrong_bypass`.
  ETR calculation is modified to *amplify* the ETR of low-confidence lines, making
  them more susceptible to eviction and thus reducing `kept_dead` errors.
  `bypass_confidence` initializes to ZERO to be more conservative initially.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11

- name: deconfident_rdp_gt
  place: condition
  params:
    rdp_table: table
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    threshold: {int: [0, 127]}
    scale: {int: [0, 16]}
  means: >
    Reads the value 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent entry in rdp_table is treated as a value of 0. The conf_table is assumed to be
    fully initialized, and its maximum value is 3.
    Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val) * scale).
    If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0.

  place: condition
  params:
    rdp_table: table
    conf_table: table

    scale: {int: [0, 16]}
  means: >

    An absent rdp_val is treated as 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized,
    and its maximum value is 3.
    Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val) * scale).
    If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0.
    Calculates a predicted_etr value as adjusted_rdp divided by div, using integer division.
    Returns true if predicted_etr is greater than the absolute value of the victim way's key.

- name: confidence_ranked_etr
  place: value
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:

    index: signature
    max_etr:

    rdp_table: table

    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. 'conf_val' is read from its table, with an
    absent entry read as its init value (0). The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    If rdp_val is greater than 73, the function returns max_etr. Otherwise, it
    calculates a base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division. It calculates an
    adjustment = (3 - conf_val). The final returned value is min(max_etr, base_etr + adjustment).

    sample: state

description:
name: mj_unified_etr_conf_rank
doc: >
  Introduces a unified ETR (Estimated Time to Replacement) ranking that combines
  predicted reuse distance (RDP) with confidence. A new value word,
  `rdp_confidence_etr_rank`, calculates the ETR for incoming lines, where higher
  confidence in a high RDP prediction leads to a higher ETR (more likely to be
  evicted), and lower confidence makes the ETR more conservative. This new ETR
  is used both for setting the line's eviction priority and for bypass decisions.
  The bypass logic is simplified to a single condition, `incoming_etr_exceeds_victim`,
  which compares the incoming line's confidence-adjusted ETR against the victim's ETR,
  addressing both `wrong_bypass` and `kept_dead` mistakes more consistently.

  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - incoming_etr_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, div: 8, max_etr: 11, min_etr: 0}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip

tables:
  - name: rdp

description:
name: unified_etr_policy
doc: >
  Unifies ETR calculation with a new value word, 'unified_etr_from_rdp_conf', that
  ranks lines based on both predicted reuse distance (RDP) and confidence. This
  addresses the conflict between wrong_bypass and kept_dead errors by creating a
  more nuanced eviction priority. Low-confidence lines get a higher ETR, making
  them better eviction candidates. The policy also adopts the successful confidence-aware
  bypass logic and sampler training from top-performing designs.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -16..15
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Confidence-adjusted bypass from top designs to reduce wrong_bypass
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO                # Confidence from 0 to 3

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match: # From top designs: train confidence only on short reuses
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep: # From top designs: detrain on old entries
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace: # From top designs: detrain on eviction
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Keep special handling for unknown PCs
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    # Use the new unified ETR calculation for all known PCs
    - set: {etr: {unified_etr_from_rdp_conf: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, max_etr: 11}}}

  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}

description:
name: mj_unified_rank
doc: >
  Unifies the ranking logic for eviction and bypass decisions to address conflicting
  error types (wrong_bypass and kept_dead). A new value word, confidence_ranked_etr,
  calculates a line's eviction rank (ETR) from both its predicted reuse distance (RDP)
  and its confidence, replacing the previous fragmented logic. A corresponding new
  condition word, ranked_etr_exceeds_victim, uses the exact same ranking function to
  compare an incoming line's predicted value against the victim's value, creating a
  single, coherent policy for both insertion and eviction.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; kept at full width
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - ranked_etr_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO} # Kept at full width
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - set: {etr: {confidence_ranked_etr: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, max_etr: 11}}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access
new_words_text:
- name: confidence_ranked_etr
  place: value
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    max_etr:
      int: [0, 15]
    rdp_table: table
  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. 'conf_val' is read from its table, with an
    absent entry read as its init value (0). The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    If rdp_val is greater than 73, the function returns max_etr. Otherwise, it
    calculates a base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division. It calculates an
    adjustment = (3 - conf_val). The final returned value is min(max_etr, base_etr + adjustment).
- name: ranked_etr_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    max_etr:

    Calculates a predicted_etr for the incoming line. It reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index]
    and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index]. An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0, and an absent
    'conf_val' is read as its init value (0). The max confidence is 3. If rdp_val > 73,
    predicted_etr is max_etr. Otherwise, predicted_etr is min(max_etr, (rdp_val / div) + (3 - conf_val)).
    The condition is true if this predicted_etr is greater than the absolute value of the victim way's key.
- name: train_sampler_match
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    conf_thresh:

    index: signature

    rdp_table: table
    sample: state
    scale:
      int: [1, 2]
  means: >
    Performs training for a sampler match based on the reuse distance 'sample' (age).
    First, it trains the rdp_table using the 'toward' operation. The target value is min(sample * scale, rdp_table.max). The entry moves one step toward the target if the difference from the target is at least min_diff.

name: mj_unified_rank_strong_conf
doc: >
  Reverts the unsuccessful EMA training and builds on the best confidence-based
  designs. Introduces a new value word, 'unified_etr_rank', to create a single,
  nuanced eviction score from both predicted reuse distance (RDP) and confidence.
  This unified ranking replaces the complex, multi-step ETR calculation to better
  address the conflict between `kept_dead` and `wrong_bypass` errors. This policy
  combines this new ranking with the proven 'train_sampler_match' step for robust
  confidence training and 'deconfident' bypass conditions for accuracy.

    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; kept at full width

victim:

  extremum: max_magnitude

  on_search: none

  that incorporates both RDP and confidence. A new value word, `confidence_penalized_etr`,

  Instead of requiring maximum confidence for bypass, RDP predictions are

  by using a new value word, `confidence_adjusted_etr`, which calculates a line's

  confidence results in a higher ETR, making the line a better eviction candidate,
  which targets `kept_dead` errors. The bypass logic remains confidence-aware to
  mitigate `wrong_bypass` errors. Confidence is trained selectively on short-latency
  reuses.

    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

description:
name: unified_confidence_policy
doc: >
  This design introduces a unified confidence mechanism to address both wrong bypasses
  and premature evictions. A new ETR calculation gives a 'stickiness' bonus to
  resident lines with low-confidence reuse predictions, reducing kept_dead errors.
  The bypass conditions are simultaneously made more conservative by penalizing the
  predicted reuse of incoming lines with low confidence, reducing wrong_bypass errors.
  This creates a coherent policy that is conservative about both evicting residents
  and bypassing newcomers when its predictions are uncertain.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - penalized_rdp_bypass: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: confidence_table, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, penalty: 4}
    - penalized_etr_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: confidence_table, index: pc_sig, div: 8, penalty: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: confidence_table
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - train: {table: confidence_table, index: signature, op: decrement}
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: confidence_table, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: confidence_table, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}

            conf_table: confidence_table
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            max_etr: 11
            bonus: 1

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

- name: etr_from_rdp_and_confidence
  place: value
  params:
    rdp_table: table
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    div: {int: [1, 128]}
    max_etr: {int: [0, 15]}
    bonus: {int: [0, 4]}
  means: >
    Reads `rdp_val` from rdp_table[index] and `conf_val` from conf_table[index].
    An absent `rdp_val` is treated as 0. An absent `conf_val` is treated as 0.
    The maximum value for confidence is 3. If `rdp_val` is greater than 73, the
    function returns `max_etr`. Otherwise, it calculates a `base_etr = rdp_val / div`
    using integer division. It calculates an `adjustment = bonus * (3 - conf_val)`.

    negative, it is treated as 0. Calculates a `predicted_etr` value as

  Introduces a unified eviction rank calculation to better balance bypass and eviction decisions.
  A new value word, unified_confidence_rank_v2, computes a line's eviction timer (ETR)
  as a single function of its predicted reuse distance (RDP) and confidence. This replaces
  a series of distinct rules with a more principled, continuous ranking function, aiming
  to reduce both `kept_dead` and `wrong_bypass` errors by creating a more accurate
  and consistent valuation for all non-zero-confidence cache lines. The proven heuristic of
  aggressively evicting zero-confidence lines is retained.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence, a proven effective heuristic.
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, determine ETR using a unified rank from RDP and confidence.
    - set:
        etr:
          unified_confidence_rank_v2:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access
new_words_text:
- name: deconfident_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
  means: 'Reads ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An absent rdp_val
    is treated as 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized, and its maximum value is 3. Calculates
    an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val) * scale). If the result of the subtraction
    is negative, it is treated as 0. Calculates a predicted_etr value as adjusted_rdp divided by div,
    using integer division. Returns true if predicted_etr is greater than the absolute value of the victim
    way''s key.'
- name: deconfident_rdp_gt
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
    threshold:
      int: [0, 127]
  means: 'Reads the value ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An
    absent entry in rdp_table is treated as a value of 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized,
    and its maximum value is 3. Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val)
    * scale). If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0. Returns true if this adjusted_rdp
    is greater than the threshold.

    '
- name: train_sampler_match
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    conf_thresh:
      int: [0, 127]
    index: signature
    min_diff:
      int: [0, 127]
    rdp_table: table
    sample: state
    scale:
      int: [1, 2]
  means: >
    Performs training for a sampler match based on the reuse distance 'sample' (age).
    First, it trains the rdp_table using the 'toward' operation. The target value is min(sample * scale, rdp_table.max). The entry moves one step toward the target if the difference from the target is at least min_diff.
    Second, if the 'sample' value is less than conf_thresh, it increments the conf_table entry at the same index.
- name: unified_confidence_rank_v2
  place: value
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    max_etr:
      int: [0, 15]
    rdp_table: table
  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    If rdp_table[index] is absent, returns 0.
    If 'rdp_val' is greater than 73, returns max_etr.
    Otherwise, it calculates a base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division.
    'conf_val' is read from its table, with an absent entry read as its init value (0).
    The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    It calculates an adjustment = (3 - conf_val).
    The final returned value is min(max_etr, base_etr + adjustment).

  the previous lenient bypass with more nuanced conditions that scale with confidence,
  and adjusts the ETR of new lines similarly. This should reduce wrong bypasses
  while improving overall ranking accuracy.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, scale: 8, threshold: 73}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, scale: 8, div: 8}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: bypass_confidence
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement}
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - set: {etr: {deconfident_etr_v2: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, scale: 8, div: 8, max_etr: 11, high_rdp_thresh: 73}}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

- name: deconfident_rdp_gt
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
    threshold:
      int: [0, 127]
  means: 'Reads the value ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An
    absent entry in rdp_table is treated as a value of 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized,
    and its maximum value is 3. Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val)
    * scale). If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0. Returns true if this adjusted_rdp
    is greater than the threshold.

    conf_table: table
    div: {int: [1, 128]}
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale: {int: [0, 16]}
    max_etr: {int: [0, 15]}
    high_rdp_thresh: {int: [0, 127]}

description:
name: mj_etr_cost_function
doc: >
  Unifies the ETR calculation for inserted/promoted lines by applying a
  confidence-based cost. A new value word, etr_with_confidence_cost, calculates
  ETR from the predicted reuse distance (RDP) and adds a penalty for low confidence.
  This makes low-confidence lines more prone to eviction, targeting `kept_dead`
  errors. The existing conservative bypass logic is retained to control
  `wrong_bypass` errors.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Retain the conservative bypass logic from the parent design
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence, a proven heuristic
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, calculate ETR using a new unified cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access
new_words_text:
- name: deconfident_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
  means: 'Reads ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An absent rdp_val
    is treated as 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized, and its maximum value is 3. Calculates

- name: deconfident_rdp_gt
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table

description:
name: mj_unified_confident_etr
doc: >
  Introduces a unified Estimated Time to Reuse (ETR) metric that incorporates
  both reuse distance prediction (RDP) and confidence. A new 'confident_etr_value'
  word calculates ETR for both incoming and resident lines, penalizing low-confidence
  predictions. The bypass logic is simplified to a single condition comparing this
  confident ETR against the victim's ETR, aiming to reduce both wrong_bypass and
  should_bypass mistakes by providing a more robust ranking.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 4                   # GRANULARITY: age faster
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - incoming_etr_exceeds_victim_confident: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, div: 8, conf_penalty_scale: 1, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: bypass_confidence
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      # Prefetch case: decrement confidence, train RDP with scale 2
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement}
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
        stop: true
      # Non-prefetch case: decrement confidence, train RDP
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement}
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 4}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 4}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Set ETR using the new confident_etr_value, which incorporates RDP and confidence
    - set: {etr: {confident_etr_value: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, div: 8, conf_penalty_scale: 1, max_etr: 11}}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index]. An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0.

description:
name: mj_unified_bypass
doc: >
  Builds on the unified ETR metric by making the bypass decision use the exact
  same ETR calculation. A new condition word, unified_etr_exceeds_victim,
  compares the incoming line's confidence-penalized ETR to the victim's ETR.
  This creates a fully consistent ranking for both resident and incoming lines,
  aiming to reduce both wrong_bypass and kept_dead errors.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Retain the absolute bypass for very long predicted reuse with low confidence
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    # Use the new unified ETR comparison for the relative bypass
    - unified_etr_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence, a proven heuristic
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, calculate ETR using the unified cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
name: mj_unified_confidence_rank
doc: >
  Unifies the ranking for both resident and incoming cache lines using a single,
  confidence-adjusted metric. The Estimated Time to Reuse (ETR) for all lines,
  and the bypass decision for incoming lines, are now based on a Reuse Distance
  Prediction (RDP) value that is penalized by its confidence. Low-confidence
  predictions are made more conservative (predicting shorter reuse), aiming to
  reduce both wrong bypasses and premature evictions (kept_dead) by creating a
  more consistent and robust ranking across the entire policy.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: bypass_confidence
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement}
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}

      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - set:
        etr:
          scaled_confidence_penalty_etr:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: bypass_confidence
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 4
            max_etr: 11

description:
name: mj_unified_bypass
doc: >
  Unifies bypass and insertion ETR calculation using a single confidence-based
  cost function. A new condition word, unified_etr_exceeds_victim, evaluates
  incoming lines for bypass using the same logic that etr_with_confidence_cost
  uses to set ETR for resident lines. This addresses inconsistent criteria for
  bypass and eviction, targeting both wrong_bypass and kept_dead errors.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - unified_etr_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence, a proven heuristic
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, calculate ETR using a new unified cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access
