description:
name: mj_unified_etr_rank
doc: >
  Unifies the ETR calculation for all lines (incoming and resident) by introducing a
  single `unified_etr_rank` function. This function integrates both predicted reuse
  distance (RDP) and confidence, explicitly setting ETR to maximum for zero-confidence
  lines. Bypass decisions now directly use this unified rank, comparing the incoming
  line's rank against a threshold or the victim's rank, aiming for more consistent
  and accurate eviction and bypass decisions to reduce `kept_dead` and `wrong_bypass`
  errors.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Bypass if the incoming line's unified ETR rank is very high (unlikely to be reused soon)
    - incoming_rank_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11, threshold: 10}
    # Bypass if the incoming line's unified ETR rank is worse than the victim's
    - incoming_rank_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Calculate ETR using the new unified rank function for all lines
    - set:
        etr:
          unified_etr_rank:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

    Returns true if incoming_etr is greater than the absolute value of the victim way's key.

      int: [0, 127]

    sample: state
    scale:
      int: [1, 2]
  means: >
    Performs training for a sampler match based on the reuse distance 'sample' (age).
    First, it trains the rdp_table using the 'toward' operation. The target value is min(sample * scale, rdp_table.max). The entry moves one step toward the target if the difference from the target is at least min_diff.
    Second, if the 'sample' value is less than conf_thresh, it increments the conf_table entry at the same index.

description:
name: mj_unified_value_function
doc: >
  Implements a unified, consistent value function for both bypass and eviction decisions, as suggested by the guidance.
  Low-confidence predictions now consistently increase a line's estimated time to reuse (ETR), making it a candidate
  for both bypass and early eviction. This addresses the inconsistency where low confidence previously discouraged bypass
  but encouraged eviction. This is achieved by introducing new condition words for bypass (`penalized_etr_*`) and a
  new value word for ETR calculation (`etr_with_confidence_cost`) that share the same underlying formula.
  Additionally, sampler training is refined by re-introducing the successful `train_sampler_match` logic.

description:
name: mj_unified_etr_confidence
doc: >
  Unifies the ETR calculation for inserted/promoted lines and bypass decisions by
  applying a confidence-based cost. A new value word, etr_with_confidence_cost,
  calculates ETR from the predicted reuse distance (RDP) and adds a penalty for
  low confidence. This makes low-confidence lines more prone to eviction, targeting
  `kept_dead` errors. The bypass logic is updated to use confidence-aware ETR
  comparisons (incoming_etr_gt_threshold and incoming_etr_exceeds_victim), aiming
  to reduce `wrong_bypass` errors by making bypass decisions more robust. Sampler
  training for confidence is updated to match the top-performing designs.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Use confidence-aware ETR for bypass decisions
    - incoming_etr_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 9, scale: 2, div: 8, max_etr: 11}
    - incoming_etr_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf              # Renamed from bypass_confidence
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match: # Adopted from top-performing design
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep: # Adopted from top-performing design
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace: # Adopted from top-performing design
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence, a proven heuristic
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, calculate ETR using a new unified cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
name: mj_unified_deconfident_etr_v2
doc: >
  Unifies the Estimated Time to Reuse (ETR) calculation for both resident and
  incoming lines by consistently applying a 'deconfident' RDP value. This
  design replaces the previous ETR calculation with a new value word,
  'deconfident_etr_val', which computes ETR by penalizing the RDP value
  based on confidence (lower confidence reduces the effective RDP, making the
  line less evictable). This strategy, derived from top-performing designs,
  aims to reduce 'wrong_bypass' and 'kept_dead' mistakes by being conservative
  with low-confidence predictions. The bypass logic also adopts the same
  confidence-adjusted RDP calculations for consistency.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -16..15, effectively -11..11 with current rules
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Use confidence-adjusted RDP for bypass decisions, aligning with successful designs.
    # Low confidence reduces the effective RDP, making lines less likely to bypass.
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf              # Renamed from bypass_confidence for consistency with deconfident_ words
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO                # 0 means high confidence, 3 means low confidence

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement} # Match means good, so increase confidence (decrease rdp_conf value)
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: increment} # Old entry not matched, decrease confidence (increase rdp_conf value)
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: increment} # Replaced entry not matched, decrease confidence (increase rdp_conf value)
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Use the new deconfident ETR calculation for setting the line's eviction rank
    - set:
        etr:
          deconfident_etr_val:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 4
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access
new_words_text:
- name: deconfident_etr_val
  place: value
  params:
    rdp_table: table
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    div: {int: [1, 128]}
    scale: {int: [0, 16]}
    max_etr: {int: [0, 15]}
  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. An absent 'conf_val' is read as its
    init value (0). The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val) * scale).
    If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0.

name: hcr_unified_penalized_rank
doc: >
  Introduces a unified, confidence-penalizing rank function to consistently value
  lines at insertion and for bypass decisions. Low-confidence predictions of long
  reuse are penalized, resulting in a lower rank (shorter lifetime), which targets
  `kept_dead` errors. This same penalty makes bypass less likely for low-confidence
  lines, targeting `wrong_bypass` errors. This replaces the contradictory logic of
  previous designs.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11, represents rank/lifetime
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - hcr_penalized_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}

  - name: rdp

    max: 95                   # INF_RD

  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10

description:
# Reference: DPC4-ChampSim/replacement/mockingjay, single-core build. Sizes are for
# the DPC4 LLC, 4096 x 12: INF_RD 95, INF_ETR 11, MAX_RD 73, 11-bit signatures,
# 32 sampled sets. The multi-core build folds the core id instead of the hit bit,
# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay_insert_to_evict
doc: >
  Corrected a schema validation error for the 'etr' field, which is signed.
  The literal '15' is now used instead of 'MAX' when assigning the highest ETR
  value, aligning with the stated intent of inserting lines with a long reuse
  distance with the maximum possible ETR (15) for a 5-bit signed field.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -16..15
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 15}} # Fixed: Changed from MAX to 15 for signed 5-bit etr.
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
name: mj_unified_confidence_rank
doc: >
  Unifies the ETR calculation for insertion, promotion, and bypass decisions by
  introducing a single confidence-penalized ETR rank. This rank is calculated
  based on predicted reuse distance (RDP) and a penalty for low confidence.
  This approach directly addresses the inconsistency between bypass and eviction
  decisions, aiming to reduce both `wrong_bypass` and `kept_dead` errors.
  The confidence training remains aligned with previous successful designs where
  sampler matches decrease the confidence counter (implying higher confidence),
  and non-matches increase it.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: back to Mockingjay's default
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Use the new unified ETR rank for both absolute and relative bypass conditions
    - unified_etr_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, div: 8, max_etr: 11, penalty_scale: 4, threshold: 9}
    - unified_etr_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, div: 8, max_etr: 11, penalty_scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: bypass_confidence
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement} # Confidence increases on match
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 8}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: increment} # Confidence decreases if not reused before sweep
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: increment} # Confidence decreases if not reused before replacement
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}} # Back to default aging
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}} # Back to default aging

    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}

            index: pc_sig

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:

description:
name: mj_unified_etr_confidence_v2
doc: >
  Unifies the Estimated Time to Reuse (ETR) calculation for both insertion
  and bypass decisions using a single confidence-adjusted ETR value function.
  This directly addresses the feedback regarding conflicting criteria in bypass
  and eviction decisions, aiming to reduce `wrong_bypass` and `kept_dead` errors.
  New condition words `incoming_etr_cost_exceeds_victim` and
  `incoming_etr_cost_gt_threshold` are introduced, which use the same
  `etr_with_confidence_cost` logic as insertion. The ETR aging rate is
  increased by changing `etr_clock` to trigger every 8 accesses, to address
  `kept_dead` errors. The `scale` parameter for confidence penalty is unified
  to 4 for all ETR calculations.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 3                  # Changed width for faster aging (every 8 accesses)
    init: 4                   # GRANULARITY: age faster
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Unified bypass conditions using the confidence-adjusted ETR cost
    - incoming_etr_cost_gt_threshold:
        rdp_table: rdp
        conf_table: rdp_conf
        index: pc_sig
        div: 8
        scale: 4              # Unified scale
        max_etr: 11
        threshold: 9          # Derived from previous threshold 73 / div 8
    - incoming_etr_cost_exceeds_victim:
        rdp_table: rdp
        conf_table: rdp_conf
        index: pc_sig
        div: 8
        scale: 4              # Unified scale
        max_etr: 11

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf              # Consolidated confidence table
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # Too old to be a reuse distance, sweep will detrain
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement} # Decrement confidence for old lines
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement} # Decrement confidence for replaced lines
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 4}} # Trigger aging every 8 accesses
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 4}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}} # Reset etr_clock after aging
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Set ETR using the unified confidence-adjusted cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 4          # Unified scale
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
name: unified_confidence_boost
doc: >
  Revises the ETR calculation and bypass logic to use a "confidence-boosted" approach.
  A new value word, `confidence_boosted_etr`, calculates ETR by *adding* a penalty
  for low confidence to the base RDP-derived ETR, making low-confidence lines more
  prone to eviction. This unified ETR is used for both setting line ranks and for
  bypass decisions via `incoming_boosted_etr_exceeds_victim`. The sampler's confidence
  training is also corrected to align with this interpretation of confidence (higher
  `conf_val` means higher confidence). This aims to reduce both `wrong_bypass`
  and `kept_dead` errors by consistent, confidence-aware ranking.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Use the new confidence-boosted ETR for bypass decisions
    - incoming_boosted_etr_exceeds_victim:
        rdp_table: rdp
        conf_table: bypass_confidence
        index: pc_sig
        div: 8
        scale: 2              # Consistent scale with ETR calculation
        max_etr: 11
        rdp_inf_threshold: 73

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: bypass_confidence
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement} # Correct: decrease confidence for long age
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: bypass_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement} # Correct: decrease confidence for replaced
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence (low conf_val), a proven heuristic
    - when: {table: {table: bypass_confidence, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}} # Set to max ETR for immediate eviction
      stop: true # Stop further ETR calculation for this line
    - set:
        etr:
          confidence_boosted_etr:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: bypass_confidence
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2              # Consistent scale
            max_etr: 11
            rdp_inf_threshold: 73

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

- name: confidence_boosted_etr
  place: value
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div: {int: [1, 128]}
    index: signature
    max_etr: {int: [0, 15]}
    rdp_table: table
    scale: {int: [0, 16]}
    rdp_inf_threshold: {int: [0, 127]}
  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. An absent 'conf_val' is treated as 0.
    The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    If rdp_val is greater than rdp_inf_threshold, the returned value is max_etr.
    Otherwise, calculate base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division.

  place: step

    conf_table: table
    conf_thresh:
      int: [0, 127]
    index: signature
    min_diff:
      int: [0, 127]
    rdp_table: table
    sample: state

      int: [1, 2]

description:
name: mj_bypass_all_residents
doc: >
  Improves bypass decisions by comparing an incoming line's rank against all
  resident lines, not just the victim. A new condition word,
  `incoming_rank_exceeds_all_residents`, is introduced to bypass a line only if
  it is predicted to be reused later than every line currently in the set. This
  more robust and conservative bypass logic aims to reduce `wrong_bypass` errors.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Bypass if the incoming line's unified ETR rank is very high (unlikely to be reused soon)
    - incoming_rank_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11, threshold: 10}
    # Bypass if the incoming line's unified ETR rank is worse than ALL resident lines
    - incoming_rank_exceeds_all_residents: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Calculate ETR using the new unified rank function for all lines
    - set:
        etr:
          unified_etr_rank:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
name: mj_robust_bypass
doc: >
  Introduces a more robust bypass condition, `bypass_if_worse_than_all`, which compares
  the incoming line's rank against all resident lines. This replaces the previous,
  more aggressive bypass heuristics to specifically target and reduce `wrong_bypass` errors,
  as suggested by the run guidance.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Bypass only if the incoming line is predicted to be worse than all resident lines.
    - bypass_if_worse_than_all: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Calculate ETR using the unified rank function for all lines
    - set:
        etr:
          unified_etr_rank:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}

- name: unified_etr_rank
  place: value
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div: {int: [1, 128]}
    index: signature
    max_etr: {int: [0, 15]}
    rdp_table: table
    scale: {int: [0, 16]}
  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. An absent 'conf_val' is treated as 0.
    The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    If 'conf_val' is 0, the returned value is max_etr.
    Otherwise, calculates base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division.
    Calculates penalty = (3 - conf_val) * scale.
    The final returned value is min(max_etr, base_etr + penalty).
- name: bypass_if_worse_than_all
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div: {int: [1, 128]}
    index: signature
    max_etr: {int: [0, 15]}
    rdp_table: table
    scale: {int: [0, 16]}

    Calculates the rank of the incoming line (incoming_rank) using the same logic as the
    'unified_etr_rank' value word. This is: Read 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and
    'conf_val' from conf_table[index], treating absent as 0. If 'conf_val' is 0,
    incoming_rank is max_etr. Otherwise, base_etr = rdp_val / div, penalty = (3 - conf_val) * scale,
    and incoming_rank = min(max_etr, base_etr + penalty). The condition then iterates through
    all resident ways in the set. It is true if and only if for every resident line,
    the absolute value of incoming_rank is greater than the absolute value of the resident line's
    'etr' field. If the set is empty or any resident line has a rank that is worse or equal,
    the condition is false.
- name: train_sampler_match
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    conf_thresh:
      int: [0, 127]
    index: signature
    min_diff:
      int: [0, 127]
    rdp_table: table
    sample: state
    scale:
      int: [1, 2]
  means: >
    Performs training for a sampler match based on the reuse distance 'sample' (age).
    First, it trains the rdp_table using the 'toward' operation. The target value is min(sample * scale, rdp_table.max). The entry moves one step toward the target if the difference from the target is at least min_diff.
    Second, if the 'sample' value is less than conf_thresh, it increments the conf_table entry at the same index.

description:
name: mj_unified_rank_metric_improved_confidence
doc: >
  Improves confidence training by introducing a new step word `train_confidence_on_accuracy`
  that adjusts `rdp_conf` based on how accurately the predicted reuse distance (RDP)
  matches the actual reuse distance (age). The sampler now stores the predicted RDP
  at install time. The original `train_sampler_match` is split into `train_rdp_only`
  (for RDP table) and the new `train_confidence_on_accuracy` (for confidence table).
  Existing confidence decrements in `sweep` and `on_replace` are retained to handle
  cases of no reuse or late reuse, complementing the accuracy-based training. This
  aims to create a more robust and responsive confidence mechanism, which should
  improve the overall accuracy of the `etr_with_confidence_cost` metric and thus
  reduce `kept_dead` and `wrong_bypass` errors.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # If confidence is zero, the line is considered useless. Bypass it.
    - table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}
    # Use new unified rank for bypass > threshold check
    - unified_rank_bypass_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, threshold: 9}
    # Use new unified rank for bypass > victim check
    - unified_rank_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
      - {name: predicted_rdp_val, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO} # New: stores predicted RDP at install
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_rdp_only: {rdp_table: rdp, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16} # Only RDP training
        train_confidence_on_accuracy: {conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, predicted_rdp_field: predicted_rdp_val, actual_age_field: age, correct_window: 16} # New: Accuracy-based confidence training
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_rdp_only: {rdp_table: rdp, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16} # Only RDP training
        train_confidence_on_accuracy: {conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, predicted_rdp_field: predicted_rdp_val, actual_age_field: age, correct_window: 16} # New: Accuracy-based confidence training
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement} # Keep decrement for long reuse
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement} # Keep decrement for no reuse before eviction
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}, predicted_rdp_val: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig}}} # New: Store predicted RDP at install
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence, a proven heuristic
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, calculate ETR using the unified cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]

    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].

  means: >

    Calculates a penalty = (3 - conf_val) * scale.

- name: unified_rank_exceeds_victim

  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. An absent 'conf_val' is treated as 0.
    The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    Calculates a base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division.
    Calculates a penalty = (3 - conf_val) * scale.
    Calculates a predicted_etr = base_etr + penalty.
    Returns true if this predicted_etr is greater than the absolute value of the victim way's key.
- name: train_rdp_only
  place: step
  params:
    rdp_table: table
    index: signature
    sample: state
    scale: {int: [1, 2]}
    min_diff: {int: [0, 127]}
  means: >
    Performs training for the rdp_table using the 'toward' operation.
    The target value is min(sample * scale, rdp_table.max).
    The entry moves one step toward the target if the difference from the target is at least min_diff.
- name: train_confidence_on_accuracy
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    predicted_rdp_field: state
    actual_age_field: state
    correct_window: {int: [0, 127]}
  means: >
    Reads 'predicted_rdp' from predicted_rdp_field and 'actual_age' from actual_age_field.
    Calculates the absolute difference: diff = abs(predicted_rdp - actual_age).
    If diff <= correct_window, then conf_table[index] is incremented (saturating).
    Otherwise, conf_table[index] is decremented (saturating).

description:
name: mj_accuracy_trained_confidence
doc: >
  Improves confidence training by directly measuring prediction accuracy. A new step
  word, `train_on_prediction_accuracy`, compares the predicted reuse distance (from
  the RDP table) with the actual reuse distance (from the sampler's age) on a
  sampler hit. Confidence is increased for accurate predictions and decreased for
  inaccurate ones. This more precise confidence measure should improve the
  effectiveness of the confidence-aware ranking (`etr_with_confidence_cost`) and
  bypass (`deconfident_*`) mechanisms inherited from the parent design, aiming to
  reduce both `kept_dead` and `wrong_bypass` errors.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Retain the conservative bypass logic from the parent design
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      # 1. Train confidence based on prediction accuracy *before* updating the RDP table.
      - train_on_prediction_accuracy:
          rdp_table: rdp
          conf_table: rdp_conf
          index: signature
          actual_rd: age
          tolerance: 16
      # 2. Train the RDP table toward the actual reuse distance, then free the entry.
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence, a proven heuristic
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, calculate ETR using a unified cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

- name: deconfident_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:

    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
  means: 'Reads ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An absent rdp_val
    is treated as 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized, and its maximum value is 3. Calculates
    an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val) * scale). If the result of the subtraction
    is negative, it is treated as 0. Calculates a predicted_etr value as adjusted_rdp divided by div,

    The maximum value for confidence is 3.

    Calculates a penalty = (3 - conf_val) * scale.

    the tolerance, it increments the entry in conf_table[index]. Otherwise, it

description:
name: mj_improved_confidence_training
doc: >
  Improves confidence training by introducing a new step word, train_long_reuse_confidence.
  This word specifically adjusts the confidence table (rdp_conf) when a sampler entry
  is swept or replaced, based on whether the RDP prediction for that signature (from
  the rdp table) correctly anticipated a long reuse. This addresses the previous
  limitation where confidence was primarily trained only for short reuses, and aims to
  improve overall rank prediction accuracy to reduce `kept_dead` and `wrong_bypass` errors.
  The existing bypass logic and ETR cost function are retained as they currently provide
  a good balance, and the focus is on refining the underlying prediction.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Retain the conservative bypass logic from the parent design
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        # New confidence training for long reuse outcomes
        train_long_reuse_confidence: {conf_table: rdp_conf, rdp_table: rdp, index: signature, long_reuse_threshold: 48}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      # New confidence training for long reuse outcomes
      train_long_reuse_confidence: {conf_table: rdp_conf, rdp_table: rdp, index: signature, long_reuse_threshold: 48}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence, a proven heuristic
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, calculate ETR using a new unified cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

- name: deconfident_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
  means: 'Reads ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An absent rdp_val
    is treated as 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized, and its maximum value is 3. Calculates
    an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val) * scale). If the result of the subtraction
    is negative, it is treated as 0. Calculates a predicted_etr value as adjusted_rdp divided by div,
    using integer division. Returns true if predicted_etr is greater than the absolute value of the victim
    way''s key.'

  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
    threshold:
      int: [0, 127]
  means: 'Reads the value ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An
    absent entry in rdp_table is treated as a value of 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized,
    and its maximum value is 3. Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val)
    * scale). If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0. Returns true if this adjusted_rdp
    is greater than the threshold.

    '
- name: etr_with_confidence_cost
  place: value
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    max_etr:
      int: [0, 15]
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. An absent 'conf_val' is treated as 0.
    The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    Calculates a base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division.
    Calculates a penalty = (3 - conf_val) * scale.
    The final returned value is min(max_etr, base_etr + penalty).
- name: train_sampler_match
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    conf_thresh:
      int: [0, 127]
    index: signature
    min_diff:
      int: [0, 127]
    rdp_table: table
    sample: state
    scale:
      int: [1, 2]
  means: >
    Performs training for a sampler match based on the reuse distance 'sample' (age).
    First, it trains the rdp_table using the 'toward' operation. The target value is min(sample * scale, rdp_table.max). The entry moves one step toward the target if the difference from the target is at least min_diff.
    Second, if the 'sample' value is less than conf_thresh, it increments the conf_table entry at the same index.
- name: train_long_reuse_confidence
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    rdp_table: table
    index: signature
    long_reuse_threshold: {int: [0, 127]}
  means: >
    Reads 'predicted_rdp' from rdp_table[index]. If 'predicted_rdp' is absent, it's treated as 0.
    If 'predicted_rdp' is greater than or equal to 'long_reuse_threshold', then the prediction
    was for a long reuse. In this case, the 'conf_table[index]' is incremented.
    Otherwise (if 'predicted_rdp' was less than 'long_reuse_threshold', implying a short reuse prediction),
    the prediction was wrong given a long actual reuse outcome. In this case, 'conf_table[index]' is decremented.
    All increments/decrements are saturating.

description:
name: mj_confidence_feedback_v1
doc: >
  Implements a direct feedback mechanism for confidence training to improve rank
  accuracy, as suggested by the guidance. On a sampler hit, the actual reuse
  distance is compared to the prediction stored at fill time. Confidence is
  incremented for accurate predictions and decremented for inaccurate ones. This is
  realized by a new `train_confidence_on_match` step word. To stay within the
  metadata budget, the sampler ways are reduced from 5 to 4.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Bypass if the incoming line's unified ETR rank is very high (unlikely to be reused soon)
    - incoming_rank_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11, threshold: 10}
    # Bypass if the incoming line's unified ETR rank is worse than the victim's
    - incoming_rank_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 4                   # Reduced from 5 to 4 for metadata budget
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
      - {name: predicted_rdp, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO} # Stores RDP prediction at fill time
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      # Stop if reuse is too long (likely an old entry for a different PC)
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      
      # if (prefetch)
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        run: train_and_free
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        stop: true
    
      # else
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16}
      - run: train_and_free

    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install:
      signature: {signature: pc_sig}
      timestamp: {read: set_clock}
      predicted_rdp: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 1} # Store current prediction
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Calculate ETR using the unified rank function for all lines
    - set:
        etr:
          unified_etr_rank:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11
  
  train_and_free:
    - train_confidence_on_match:
        conf_table: rdp_conf
        index: signature
        actual_reuse: age
        predicted_reuse: predicted_rdp
        accuracy_margin: 16
    - free: true

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

  means: >

description:
name: mj_confidence_from_accuracy
doc: >
  Introduces a new training step, `train_rdp_and_confidence`, which directly trains the confidence table based on the accuracy of the reuse distance prediction. On a sampler hit, it compares the predicted RDP with the measured RDP (age). If the prediction is accurate (within a margin), confidence is increased; otherwise, it's decreased. This provides a more direct feedback loop for learning prediction confidence, aiming to improve both bypass decisions (`wrong_bypass`) and eviction (`kept_dead`).

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Retain the conservative bypass logic from the parent design
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_rdp_and_confidence: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, error_margin: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_rdp_and_confidence: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, error_margin: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence, a proven heuristic
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, calculate ETR using a new unified cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
name: mj_accuracy_training
doc: >
  Introduces a new sampler training mechanism, `train_accuracy`, to improve prediction
  quality. On a sampler hit, it compares the predicted reuse distance with the
  actual measured distance ('age'). If the prediction is accurate (within a margin),
  the signature's confidence is increased; otherwise, it's decreased. This provides
  direct positive and negative feedback, making the confidence metric more reliable.
  The RDP table is also trained as before. This change directly addresses the guidance
  to train confidence based on prediction accuracy.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Bypass if the incoming line's unified ETR rank is very high (unlikely to be reused soon)
    - incoming_rank_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11, threshold: 10}
    # Bypass if the incoming line's unified ETR rank is worse than the victim's
    - incoming_rank_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_accuracy: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, accuracy_margin: 16, min_rdp_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_accuracy: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, accuracy_margin: 16, min_rdp_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Calculate ETR using the unified rank function for all lines
    - set:
        etr:
          unified_etr_rank:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
name: mj_accuracy_confidence
doc: >
  Improves confidence training by evaluating prediction accuracy on a sampler hit.
  A new training step, `train_rdp_and_confidence`, compares the predicted reuse
  distance (from before the RDP table is updated) with the actual observed reuse
  distance ('age'). Confidence is increased for accurate predictions and decreased
  for inaccurate ones. This provides a true feedback loop for confidence, addressing
  the guidance to learn which predictions are trustworthy. This change builds on the
  successful `mj_unified_etr_rank` design.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line

    width: 5
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock

    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8
  - name: set_clock

    kind: counter
    width: 8
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - incoming_rank_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11, threshold: 10}
    - incoming_rank_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11}

  - name: pc_sig

    hash: crc3

tables:
  - name: rdp
