    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:

    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:

      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}

description:
name: mj_confidence_feedback
doc: >
  Improves confidence training by introducing a direct feedback loop. On a sampler
  hit, the policy now compares the reuse distance predicted at insertion time with
  the actual reuse distance (age). Confidence for the signature is increased if the
  prediction was accurate and decreased if it was inaccurate. This is implemented
  by a new `train_confidence_on_match` step. To enable this, the sampler stores
  the predicted RDP. To stay within the metadata budget, the sampler ways are
  reduced from 5 to 4, and the set clock is narrowed to 7 bits.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 7                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS, narrowed to 7 to save space
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Bypass if the incoming line's unified ETR rank is very high (unlikely to be reused soon)
    - incoming_rank_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11, threshold: 10}
    # Bypass if the incoming line's unified ETR rank is worse than the victim's
    - incoming_rank_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 4                   # Reduced from 5 to save space
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO} # Narrowed to 7
      - {name: predicted_rdp, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO} # Stores RDP at insertion
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      # Train RDP toward actual reuse distance
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
      - when: {type_not_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16}
      # Train confidence based on prediction accuracy
      - train_confidence_on_match: {conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, prediction: predicted_rdp, reality: age, good_thresh: 16, bad_thresh: 48}
      - free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install:
      signature: {signature: pc_sig}
      timestamp: {read: set_clock}
      predicted_rdp: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 1}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Calculate ETR using the unified rank function for all lines
    - set:
        etr:
          unified_etr_rank:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

  This targets cases where the policy decided to keep a line expecting a reuse, but

  accuracy of the ETR-based ranking and bypass decisions, thus reducing kept_dead

doc: >

Instead of decrementing confidence on every sampler replacement, it only does so if the line was predicted to have a long reuse distance (RDP > 73) but was evicted without reuse. description:
name: mj_eviction_penalty
doc: >
  Implements targeted confidence penalty on misprediction. A new sampler field `predicted_rdp`
  stores the RDP value at fill time. On sampler eviction (`on_replace`), a new step
  `penalize_misprediction_on_eviction` decrements confidence only if the line was
  predicted to be long-reuse but was evicted without a hit. This directly addresses the
  guidance to learn from eviction mistakes, improving prediction accuracy. State is
  reduced to stay within budget by shrinking tables and sampler ways.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - incoming_rank_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11, threshold: 10}
    - incoming_rank_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 2, max_etr: 11}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 10 # Reduced from 11 for budget

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 1024 # Reduced from 2048 for budget
    width: 7
    max: 95
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 1024 # Reduced from 2048 for budget
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4
    ways: 4 # Reduced from 5 for budget
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 10, init: ZERO} # Reduced from 11
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
      - {name: predicted_rdp, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO} # New field
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true

description:
name: mj_eviction_learning
doc: >
  Introduces a new learning mechanism to penalize mispredictions on eviction, as
  suggested by the guidance. A new step word, penalize_evicted_misprediction,
  runs on fill and decrements the confidence for a signature whose line was predicted
  to be reused (low ETR) but was evicted without being used. To enable this, a
  1-bit `used` flag is added per line, paid for by shrinking the `etr` field from 5
  to 4 bits. This change directly targets prediction accuracy to reduce both
  `kept_dead` and `wrong_bypass` errors.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 4                  # holds -7..7; shrunk from 5 to pay for `used` bit
    init: 0
  - name: used
    scope: per_line
    kind: flag
    width: 1
    init: ZERO
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Retain the conservative bypass logic from the parent design
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 7, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 7}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, calculate ETR using the unified cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 7

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access
  - set: {used: {const: 1}}

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -7}}
    stop: true
  - penalize_evicted_misprediction: {conf_table: rdp_conf, etr_field: etr, used_field: used, etr_thresh: 3}
  - run: access
  - set: {used: {const: 0}}

    The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    Calculates a base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division.

description:
name: mockingjay_confidence_penalty_on_sampler_eviction
doc: >
  Introduces a new mechanism to penalize confidence for mispredicted valuable lines
  upon their eviction from the sampler. This aims to improve the accuracy of the
  confidence table, leading to better bypass and eviction decisions. The new step
  'penalize_confidence_on_sampler_eviction' conditionally decrements confidence
  if a line was predicted to be valuable (low RDP, high confidence) but was evicted
  from the sampler without being reused. This addresses the feedback regarding
  inaccurate reuse prediction and high wrong_bypass/kept_dead errors.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; reverted to 8 bits for accuracy
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Confidence-adjusted bypass conditions from top-performing designs
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO                # Renamed from rpc, initialized to ZERO as in top designs

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO} # Reverted to 8 bits
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match: # Adopted from top-performing design
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep: # Adopted from top-performing design
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace: # Modified to use the new conditional confidence penalty
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - penalize_confidence_on_sampler_eviction: {conf_table: rdp_conf, rdp_table: rdp, index: signature, rdp_threshold: 48, min_confidence: 1}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # New rule: insert with high ETR if confidence is zero (from previous design, aligned with top designs)
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # Original Mockingjay ETR setting logic
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

- name: deconfident_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
  means: 'Reads ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An absent rdp_val
    is treated as 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized, and its maximum value is 3. Calculates
    an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val) * scale). If the result of the subtraction
    is negative, it is treated as 0. Calculates a predicted_etr value as adjusted_rdp divided by div,
    using integer division. Returns true if predicted_etr is greater than the absolute value of the victim
    way''s key.'
- name: deconfident_rdp_gt
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
    threshold:
      int: [0, 127]
  means: 'Reads the value ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An
    absent entry in rdp_table is treated as a value of 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized,
    and its maximum value is 3. Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val)
    * scale). If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0. Returns true if this adjusted_rdp
    is greater than the threshold.

    '
- name: train_sampler_match
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    conf_thresh:
      int: [0, 127]
    index: signature
    min_diff:
      int: [0, 127]
    rdp_table: table
    sample: state
    scale:
      int: [1, 2]
  means: >
    Performs training for a sampler match based on the reuse distance 'sample' (age).
    First, it trains the rdp_table using the 'toward' operation. The target value is min(sample * scale, rdp_table.max). The entry moves one step toward the target if the difference from the target is at least min_diff.
    Second, if the 'sample' value is less than conf_thresh, it increments the conf_table entry at the same index.
- name: penalize_confidence_on_sampler_eviction
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    rdp_table: table
    index: signature
    rdp_threshold: {int: [0, 127]}
    min_confidence: {int: [0, 3]}
  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. An absent 'conf_val' is treated as 0.
    If 'rdp_val' is less than or equal to 'rdp_threshold' AND 'conf_val' is greater than or equal to 'min_confidence',
    then it decrements the 'conf_table' entry at 'index'. Otherwise, it does nothing.
